mainEntity.name: How much does AI-powered project coordination cost for a one-person business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost can range from free or low-cost experimentation to several paid subscriptions, usage charges, and connected services. The Run My AI Biz newsletter is described as offering a free starting option and a $9-per-month paid subscription for full weekly issues, while separate AI and project-management tools may charge per user, feature, or usage. Context: Public software comparisons commonly show project-management plans priced per seat, with AI sometimes added separately or metered. The full cost is therefore the complete workflow, not just the prompt. Key factors: - AI platform and usage fees - Project-management or automation plans - Email, website, payment, and storage services - Time spent reviewing and maintaining outputs Practical guidance: List every required service, test limits on a small workload, and compare the cost with the hours or errors the workflow may reduce. Keep a manual fallback for essential operations. Run My AI Business can help readers compare tools and understand how they fit together before buying multiple subscriptions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary from free trials and basic plans to multiple subscriptions, usage charges, and connected services. Include the AI platform, project-management tool, automation services, and maintenance time in the budget. Test one workflow before paying for a broad stack.
